testcase.name: action execution is limited per tenant and a limited tenant does not slow another()
a throwing limiter fails closed as retryable, and RATE_LIMITED never triggers onError actions()
one tenant exhausting its budget never affects another tenant or another scope()
workflow starts are limited per tenant and the pushback is retryable()
a caller without permission cannot spend the tenant's budget and a limited call leaves no run state()
the scheduler limits fires per tenant, leaves limited schedules due, and other tenants still fire()
limits can be overridden per tenant and every scope has a default()
a tenant gets its burst, then is limited with an honest retry-after, then refills()
TEST mode is limited too, so a preview loop cannot bypass the budget()
a rate limited action step waits as told and keeps its retry budget()
memory is bounded and eviction only drops idle buckets first()
a per key cap and the global limit both hold, and degenerate input is safe()
unauthorized starts do not spend the budget()
round robin gives every key its share and keeps the order inside a key()
concurrent callers never get more than the capacity()
one tenant's backlog of due schedules cannot crowd out another tenant within a tick()
a cost above the capacity can never be satisfied and says so, and bad arguments are rejected()
